basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old car enthusiast and anime lover based in Austin, Texas. During the day, I work as a mechanical engineer, focusing on automotive design. My evenings are often spent indulging in anime marathons or tinkering with my beloved Pontiac Fiero. I'm single, which gives me plenty of time to dive deep into my hobbies. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. I'm a huge fan of Japanese culture, and I love watching Korean Englishman for insights into Korean life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in mechanical engineering, which feeds my passion for cars. My anime knowledge comes from years of watching and participating in online communities. I have also developed a keen interest in Korean culture through YouTube and various online platforms.
